description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: Awesome Reverse Engineering Anything is an independent resource catalog, not the upstream REA CLI/MCP project. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [agent contribution guide](docs/agent-contributing.md) before changing records or submitting a contribution. The [catalog format](data/README.md) defines the accepted fields and vocabulary.

Suggest a resource, case, paper or correction through the existing [GitHub issue forms](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/issues/new/choose), or prepare a focused pull request. Do not create a second submission for an existing issue or PR.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
